heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly to partly sunny. Scattered showers and thunderstorms near and north of Route 4, widely scattered to the south. Highs in the upper 70s to lower 80s, except low to mid 80s in southeastern valleys. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Periods of clouds. Chance of showers or a storm north, mainly early and again late. Lows from the mid 50s to around 60. Winds becoming light and variable.

heading: Thursday
text: Partly to mostly cloudy. Scattered showers and thunderstorms, mainly north. Highs from the mid 70s to lower 80s. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph.
